concept.hr: Brzina trošenja proračuna i uzbune za brzo i sporo trošenje
concept.en: Burn rate, and fast and slow burn alerts

summary.hr: Ubaci incidente i gledaj kako se troši proračun greške. Hitna uzbuna traži brzo trošenje u dugom i kratkom prozoru; sporo trošenje hvata zahtjev.
summary.en: Inject incidents and watch the error budget drain. A page needs a fast burn over a long and a short window; a slow burn is caught by a ticket.

concept.hr: 20 min pri 100 % odnese 46 % mjesečnog proračuna od 43,2 min; hitna uzbuna
concept.en: 20 min at 100 % takes 46 % of the month's 43.2 min budget; a page

concept.hr: 1,44 % kroz sat: brzina točno 14,4, 2 % proračuna, uzbuna na pragu
concept.en: 1.44 % for an hour: burn exactly 14.4, 2 % of the budget, a page at the tie

concept.hr: 0,2 % stalno: nikoga ne budi, a proračun nestaje 15. dana; hvata ga zahtjev
concept.en: 0.2 % steadily wakes no one; the budget is gone on day 15, a ticket catches it

concept.hr: 2 min pri 100 %: hitna uzbuna, ugašena 5 min nakon kraja kratkim prozorom
concept.en: 2 min at 100 %: a page, ended 5 min later by the short window

concept.hr: 0,05 % cijeli mjesec: pola proračuna, bez ijedne uzbune, kako i treba
concept.en: 0.05 % all month: half the budget and no alert, as designed
